# cancho-flow

> A run is a claim you can check: one program, recorded as a canonical content-addressed record, read back and checked.

- [This page, as Markdown](https://alpibrusl.github.io/cancho-flow/agents.md): commands, authority, rules, limits
- [Design](https://github.com/alpibrusl/cancho-flow/blob/main/docs/design.md): decisions, gates and results
- [Repository](https://github.com/alpibrusl/cancho-flow)
